header.title: Política de cookies
header.subtitle: How TenthMatrix uses cookies and similar technologies

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This Cookie Policy explains how TenthMatrix ('we', 'us', or 'our') uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website and applications. By using our services, you consent to the use of cookies in accordance with this policy. This policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

sections.title: What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, provide a better user experience, and provide information to website owners.

subsections.subtitle: Types of Cookies by Duration
items: Session Cookies: Temporary cookies that expire when you close your browser. They help us remember what you're doing as you navigate through our site.
Persistent Cookies: Cookies that remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them. They help us recognize you as a returning visitor.

subsections.subtitle: Types of Cookies by Source
items: First-Party Cookies: Set directly by TenthMatrix and used only by us.
Third-Party Cookies: Set by external services we use (analytics, advertising, social media).

sections.title: Why We Use Cookies
sections.content: We use cookies for several important purposes to enhance your experience and improve our services:
items: Essential Functionality: To enable core features like user authentication, session management, and secure access to our platform.
Performance & Analytics: To understand how visitors interact with our website, which pages are most popular, and identify technical issues.
Personalization: To remember your preferences, language settings, and customize content based on your interests.
Security: To detect and prevent fraudulent activity, protect user accounts, and ensure platform security.
Marketing & Advertising: To deliver relevant advertisements and measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns.
AI Model Training: To improve our AI agents and machine learning models based on aggregated, anonymized usage patterns.

subsections.subtitle: Strictly Necessary Cookies
subsections.content: These cookies are essential for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled.
items: Authentication Cookies: Keep you logged in and secure (e.g., ws_session, auth_token)
Security Cookies: Protect against CSRF attacks and unauthorized access (e.g., csrf_token, security_session)
Load Balancing: Ensure your requests are routed to the correct server (e.g., lb_cookie)
subsections.details: Duration: Session or up to 24 hours

subsections.subtitle: Performance & Analytics Cookies
subsections.content: These cookies help us understand how visitors use our site and improve performance.
items: Google Analytics: Tracks page views, session duration, bounce rate (_ga, _gid, _gat)
Hotjar: Records heatmaps and user session recordings for UX improvement (_hjid, _hjSessionUser)
Custom Analytics: Our proprietary analytics for AI feature usage (ws_analytics, feature_usage)

subsections.subtitle: Functional Cookies
subsections.content: These cookies enable enhanced functionality and personalization.
items: Preference Cookies: Remember your settings (language, theme, timezone)
Chatbot State: Maintain context in AI agent conversations (chatbot_session, conversation_id)
Feature Toggles: Remember which beta features you've enabled (beta_features, ui_preferences)

subsections.subtitle: Marketing & Advertising Cookies
subsections.content: These cookies are used to track you across websites and deliver relevant advertisements.
items: Google Ads: Track conversions and retarget visitors (IDE, DSID, Conversion)
LinkedIn Insight Tag: Track B2B conversions (li_sugr, UserMatchHistory, bcookie)
Facebook Pixel: Measure ad effectiveness and create custom audiences (fr, _fbp)
Twitter/X Analytics: Track engagement from social media campaigns (personalization_id, guest_id)

subsections.subtitle: Social Media Cookies
subsections.content: These cookies enable social sharing and track social media interactions.
items: LinkedIn: Share content and track engagement
Twitter/X: Enable tweet embedding and sharing
YouTube: Display embedded videos and track video views (VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE, YSC)

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.content: We use the following third-party services that may set cookies on your device:
items: Google Analytics: Web analytics (Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy)
Google Ads & DoubleClick: Advertising (Opt-out: https://adssettings.google.com)
Hotjar: User experience analytics (Privacy: https://www.hotjar.com/legal/policies/privacy/)
Intercom: Customer communication (Privacy: https://www.intercom.com/legal/privacy)
Stripe: Payment processing (Privacy: https://stripe.com/privacy)
LinkedIn Insight: B2B marketing (Privacy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy)
Facebook Pixel: Social advertising (Opt-out: https://www.facebook.com/settings?tab=ads)
CloudFlare: CDN and DDoS protection (Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/)
AWS CloudFront: Content delivery (Privacy: https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/)
Sentry: Error tracking and monitoring (Privacy: https://sentry.io/privacy/)

sections.title: How to Manage Cookies
sections.content: You have several options to manage or disable cookies:

subsections.subtitle: Browser Settings
subsections.content: Most browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. Here's how to manage cookies in popular browsers:
items: Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data
Firefox: Settings > Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data
Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Manage Website Data
Edge: Settings > Cookies and site permissions > Manage and delete cookies
Opera: Settings > Privacy & security > Cookies and other site data

subsections.subtitle: Cookie Consent Manager
subsections.content: When you first visit our website, you'll see a cookie consent banner allowing you to:
items: Accept all cookies
Reject non-essential cookies
Customize your cookie preferences by category
Change your preferences at any time using the cookie settings link in the footer

subsections.subtitle: Opt-Out Links
items: Google Analytics: Install the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on (https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout)
Advertising: Visit Network Advertising Initiative (https://www.networkadvertising.org/choices/) or Digital Advertising Alliance (https://www.aboutads.info/choices/)
Do Not Track: Enable 'Do Not Track' in your browser (note: not all services honor this)

sections.disclaimer: Please note: Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website and prevent you from using some features, including AI agent interactions and personalized experiences.

sections.title: Detailed Cookie Reference Table
sections.content: Below is a comprehensive list of cookies we use:
details: ws_session - Session management - First-party - Session - Strictly Necessary
auth_token - User authentication - First-party - 24 hours - Strictly Necessary
csrf_token - CSRF protection - First-party - Session - Strictly Necessary
_ga - Google Analytics user ID - Third-party - 2 years - Analytics
_gid - Google Analytics session ID - Third-party - 24 hours - Analytics
_hjid - Hotjar user ID - Third-party - 1 year - Analytics
__cf_bm - CloudFlare bot management - Third-party - 30 minutes - Strictly Necessary
ws_analytics - Feature usage tracking - First-party - 1 year - Analytics

sections.title: AI Agent & Machine Learning Cookies
sections.content: As an AI-powered platform, we use specific cookies to enhance AI agent functionality:
items: Conversation Context: Maintain context across AI agent interactions (conversation_id, agent_session)
Model Preferences: Remember which AI models you prefer (gpt4, claude, gemini preferences)
Training Consent: Track your consent for using interactions to improve AI models (training_opt_in)
Agent Personalization: Customize AI agent behavior based on your industry and use case (agent_profile)
Prompt History: Cache recent prompts for faster responses (prompt_cache - stored locally, not on server)
sections.recommendation: These AI-specific cookies are essential for providing personalized, context-aware AI assistance. Disabling them will significantly impact your AI experience.

sections.title: Data Retention & Cookie Lifespan
sections.content: Different cookies have different retention periods:
items: Session Cookies: Deleted when you close your browser
Authentication Cookies: Expire after 24 hours or when you log out
Functional Cookies: Typically stored for 1 year
Analytics Cookies: Usually stored for up to 2 years
Marketing Cookies: Can persist for up to 2 years, depending on the provider
details: You can delete all cookies at any time through your browser settings.
We periodically review and clean up unused cookies to minimize data storage.
Cookie data older than their specified retention period is automatically deleted.

sections.title: Mobile Applications & SDKs
sections.content: Our mobile applications use similar tracking technologies including:
items: Mobile SDKs: Firebase, Mixpanel, Amplitude for analytics
Advertising IDs: IDFA (iOS) and AAID (Android) for personalized ads
Push Notification Tokens: To send you important updates
Device Fingerprinting: For security and fraud prevention
Local Storage: To cache data and improve app performance
sections.recommendation: You can manage mobile tracking through your device settings (iOS: Settings > Privacy > Tracking; Android: Settings > Privacy > Ads).

sections.title: GDPR & International Compliance
sections.content: We are committed to complying with GDPR, CCPA, and other international privacy regulations:
items: Consent Management: We obtain explicit consent for non-essential cookies in EU/EEA
Right to Withdraw: You can withdraw cookie consent at any time
Data Portability: Request a copy of data collected via cookies
Right to Erasure: Request deletion of cookie-related data
CCPA Opt-Out: California residents can opt-out of cookie-based selling of personal information
sections.contact: To exercise your rights, contact us at privacy@tenthmatrix.com or use our Data Subject Request form.

sections.title: Changes to This Cookie Policy
sections.content: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, legal requirements, or other factors. When we make significant changes, we will notify you by:
items: Updating the 'Last Updated' date at the top of this policy
Displaying a prominent notice on our website for 30 days
Sending an email notification to registered users (for material changes)
Requesting renewed consent if required by law
sections.recommendation: We encourage you to review this Cookie Policy periodically to stay informed about how we use cookies.
